title: UnenforcedAny
$comment: A `not` whose operand carries a keyword nothing models. The operand is outside the runtime evaluator, and a `not` over it is outside every static arm too, so this schema becomes `type UnenforcedAny any` -- and the generated source has to say so, because a type with no Validate method looks exactly like a type that was never constrained. Three earlier spellings of this fixture stopped being unenforced and had to be replaced: contentEncoding/contentMediaType became a string wrapper with issue #115 (pinned by regression/content_posture_draft7.json), unevaluatedProperties gained an evaluator arm with issue #111 (pinned by regression/anyof_branch_unevaluated_properties.json), and `format` gained one with issue #205 (pinned by regression/typed_format_positions.json). A vendor keyword replaces it because that is the spelling that cannot stop being unmodelled: nothing is known about what an unrecognised keyword demands, so the evaluator must go on refusing it. Whatever this fixture is spelled with must be a keyword TestUnmodelledKeywordsFailClosedAndAreReported still lists as unmodelled.
